artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: baseline+git mv records to docs/reference and docs/architecture, repoint all live referrers, clear measured new docs/ gate exposure (C12/C15/C20/C9D), record placement rule and final gate.

memory_candidates.content: Relocating a file from specs/ into docs/ in BimodalLogic is not a pure rename: check-module-invariants.sh scopes several gates to docs/ + README.md and excludes specs/** (C12 slash-path resolution, C13 relative links, C15 paper-anchor citations, C20 tier-2 file.lean:NNN citations with ENFORCE_C20=1 default, C9D task-number citations). Before planning such a move, simulate it in a throwaway git worktree and diff `check-module-invariants.sh --no-build` output against baseline to measure newly exposed failures.
